newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa's Fenosa stake at odds with new laws - IndMin.
newsitem.headline: Endesa's Fenosa stake at odds with new laws - IndMin.

text.p: Spain's Industry Minister Josep Pique said on Friday that electricity group Endesa's stake in Union Fenosa was incompatible with the future regulation framework for the electricity sector.
"The government's approach is to avoid cross-holdings," Pique told reporters after the cabinet's regular meeting.
Endesa, which is 66-percent state-owned, currently holds a 7.5 percent stake in Union Fenosa.
Pique added he had instructed Endesa to take into account the new circumstances created by the future law on the sector as it applied to its holding in the Galician firm.
Endesa earlier announced it was launching a buy offer for up to 75 percent of electricity companies Fecsa and Sevillana.
